x: Ted Warren has agreed to be added to our Coaching strength and although he has his own squad of promising youths he has agreed to take a special interest next year in the welfare of members at Norbiton track.

Our outstanding youth was John Warren who competed at every opportunity and turned out in Southern League senior races whenever asked. Father Ted. has been a tower of strength and runs a sizeable training squad of promising youngsters.

Ian Horton, who will now concentrate mainly on managing the winter teams, also provided support together with coach Ted Warren and it was pleasing to see Duncan Ross helping out at all the boys and colts meetings.

Ted Warren has worked wonders with our Colts and Boys and some fine performances have resulted. Also pleasing has been the way our A and B team members have helped out with Dave Mote, Alister Johnson and John Druce turning out whenever possible at Norbiton to help younger members.
